text: e& (Emirates Telecommunications Group, the rebranded Etisalat) is 60% owned by the Emirates Investment Authority (EIA), which a US securities filing describes as an integral part of the United Arab Emirates' Federal Government.
short: e& is 60% owned by the Emirates Investment Authority (UAE federal government)

source.name: SEC Schedule 13D/A, Vodafone Group Plc, filed by Atlas 2022 Holdings Ltd, Emirates Telecommunications Group Company PJSC and the Emirates Investment Authority
source.quote: Atlas Holdings is a wholly-owned subsidiary of e&, which in turn is 60% owned by EIA
source.note: The same filing says: 'EIA is an integral part of the Federal Government and was established through Federal Decree Law No. 4 of 2007'.

additionalSources.name: AGBI (Arabian Gulf Business Insight): Etisalat / e& company profile (undated, opened 29 September 2026)
additionalSources.quote: The ownership structure changed in 1983 when the UAE government held a 60% share. The remainder is publicly traded
